verdict.rationale: Trilegal is an Indian law firm, a professional legal-services provider rather than a software platform, SaaS, framework or tool, so connecting an agent via an official MCP server is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows only an llms.txt file for AI discoverability and no MCP server or API (the OpenAPI probes all returned 404), so the exception for a product that actually ships the capability does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
